form.label: Darkmoon — Remediation & Retest
form.description: Observed local proposals, published PRs and retest comparisons within the selected time range. Local validation and not_observed are not proof of a deployed fix. PR bodies and finding evidence are excluded.

search.query: `darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:pr | dedup pr_id sortby -_indextime -_time | stats count by state

panel.title: Distinct observed comparison snapshots over time

search.query: `darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:retest verdict=* | dedup event_id | timechart count by verdict

`darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:pr | dedup pr_id sortby -_indextime -_time | eval last=strftime(_time,"%F %T") | table pr_id provider repo number state confidence campaign_id finding_ids last url
`darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:remediation | dedup proposal_id sortby -_indextime -_time | table proposal_id campaign_id finding_ids status confidence validated published

panel.title: Retest lifecycle — includes pending and empty comparisons

search.query: `darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:retest record_type=lifecycle | dedup retest_id sortby -_indextime -_time | table retest_id status base_campaign_id new_campaign_id target_id run_id

`darkmoon_index` sourcetype=darkmoon:retest verdict=* | dedup retest_id finding_key sortby -_indextime -_time | eval last=strftime(_time,"%F %T") | table retest_id finding_campaign_id finding_id current_finding_id title severity target base_status new_status verdict last
